final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.death_state AS ds, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS c FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ds AS ds, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.a) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(d) FROM s3
